### Goal ###
When the gas reads `NORMAL_OPERATION`, a registry rule fires only with strict support, so one normal-valued
SUGGESTIVE row, a `none_present` DTC row or the `NORMAL_OPERATION` chemistry row itself no longer names a fault. When
no rule fires at all, COMLab keeps the no-fault verdict and marks it abstained (`no_rule`). Other chemistry states keep
today's predicate. Done is `### Verification ###` with the P2 and P3 counts.

### Rulings that bind ###
- **R1 strict support** in `labs/comlab/registry/integration_shim.py`: a new `_strict_support(rule, obs) -> bool`
  before `_score_rule_raw`. It returns `True` when `obs.chemistry_state` is not `ChemistryState.NORMAL_OPERATION`, or
  when the rule has no non-GATING row. Otherwise it needs one satisfied non-GATING row that is DEFINITIVE or a
  positive DTC row (`any_match`, `all_match`), or two satisfied non-GATING rows, or a satisfied GATING chemistry row
  plus one. A satisfied `none_present` row and a `NORMAL_OPERATION` chemistry row never count.
  `_score_rule_raw` returns `None` when `_strict_support` is false (after the existing `any_satisfied` check).
  `_prune_attribution` returns `("missing_evidence", _GATING_KEY_WEAK_SUPPORT)` in the same case, with
  `_GATING_KEY_WEAK_SUPPORT = "weak_support_only"`, so it stays the exact complement.
- **R2 no-fire abstains** in `labs/comlab/comlab/core/fault_atlas_router.py`, the v2 abstain block: after the
  `_V2_NS_NO_RULE` branch, `elif not scored_rules:` sets `abstained = True`, `abstain_reason = "no_rule"`. An
  NF-001/NF-002 winner is not affected (it is in `scored_rules`).
- **R3 the two pins this reverses:** `labs/comlab/tests/unit/test_abstain_emit.py::test_v2_healthy_no_abstain` now
  asserts `abstained is True` and `abstain_reason == "no_rule"`. `apps/ui/tests/test_ui.py::test_e2e_abstain_case`
  also accepts `"no_rule"`.
